historical_reviews.deepseek: Its LED focus leaves the first acceptance branch—complete System information versus SPEC—unverified and does not define secure transport or restoration.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly preserves two independent checkpoints: read-only per-field system inventory and a bounded physical LED-control cycle.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The inventory branch must anchor chassis identity before the LED branch. If the page identity and physical enclosure are not proven to be the same asset, correct field values and a visible LED can come from different systems and falsely combine into one result.

original_test_intent: Validate every required System information field on the BMC Inventory and LEDs page against the approved SPEC and verify the exact same chassis's Identify/UID LED on/off behavior with controller and physical evidence.
original_method: Bind BMC, chassis and SUT identity, capture the complete System page and structured resource, normalize every approved SPEC field including units and unavailable rules, then after operator approval exercise only the mapped Identify/UID LED through on/readback/physical-on and off/readback/physical-off transitions, restore its original state and verify no unrelated control changed.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the System SPEC and approves the LED write; an operator verifies UI-only fields and exact physical on/off behavior, restoration and final verdict.
required_inputs: Complete System page SPEC field/value/unit/format matrix
Original LED state and restoration procedure
safety_requirements: Do not accept page load or a subset of fields as full SPEC coverage
Verify all data and LED control belong to the same chassis
Never map Identify to power/fault/service control
Pair each write with controller readback and physical observation
Stop on cross-host data, stale fields, wrong LED or unrelated change
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete raw and UI System inventory
Normalize and compare every SPEC field
Validate exact LED resource and baseline
Issue approved on/off writes and structured readbacks
Verify restoration and no unrelated changes
engineer_actions: Approve System SPEC and exception rules
Verify UI-only fields and same-chassis identity
Approve and observe exact LED transitions

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A generic IndicatorLED action addresses only the second half and lacks a complete System information query, field matrix, exact resource binding, safe credentials and restoration.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: First capture and compare the complete same-target System page/resource; then use the protected mapped Identify/UID resource for an operator-observed on/off/readback cycle and restore baseline.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: System information, LED on/off and 10/10-minute estimates remain as separate required checkpoints.

modernized_recommendation.status: SAME-ASSET SYSTEM INVENTORY PLUS LED CORRELATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use one chassis identity envelope containing the full per-field SPEC comparison and a timestamped digital/physical LED transition ledger, with restoration evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes all information and correct behavior measurable without reducing either branch.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: LED control cannot substitute for inventory, and correct inventory cannot prove physical LED behavior; both must independently pass for the same asset.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: UI caches and Redfish resources may refresh at different times, while shared management views can reference a chassis alias; synchronize timestamps and stable identities before comparison.

project_override_considerations: The Project must publish the authoritative System information matrix and exact Identify/UID mapping. UI-only fields need screenshot/DOM evidence and must not be silently omitted from API comparison.
expected_evidence: Verified same SUT/BMC/chassis identity, UI/firmware version and complete System SPEC matrix
Full raw structured response and UI capture with per-field normalized comparison and freshness timestamps
Exact LED resource/location and baseline controller/physical state
Protected on/off writes, readbacks and physical observations
Baseline restoration and no unrelated power/fault/service change
Audit/SEL review, exceptions, recovery actions and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria consistently require both System information validation and LED behavior. DeepSeek merely undercovers the inventory branch; the Master has no competing target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The SPEC matrix, mapping and operator evidence are normal project inputs. The two-branch workflow is identifiable and can be gated until inputs arrive.

review_improvement: Restores the omitted full inventory comparison and binds it to the same chassis as a protected, physically observed LED cycle with explicit restoration.
independent_technical_reasoning: This case asserts both descriptive identity and physical actuation. Stable chassis identifiers and synchronized evidence prevent combining a cached page from one target with an LED observation on another. Field-complete comparison and dual-oracle LED transitions are independent, so neither can stand in for the other.
